text: Navigating Compliance in Student Affairs presents the following source proposition: In response to heightened scrutiny from stakeholders, the chapter advocates for integrating talent management strategies to align institutional capabilities with external expectations. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that The threat of heightened scrutiny under a deferred prosecution or corporate integrity agreement optimizes incentives because increased government monitoring attaches only after a first time offense, giving institutions a reason to comply and self-regulate in order to avoid it.
